subject.title: feat(setup): rename Crestodian to OpenClaw system agent

question: Should protocol-v4 continue accepting both the shipped `crestodian.*` contract and the new `openclaw.*` names, or should this PR intentionally introduce a versioned incompatible client/Gateway boundary?
rationale: The PR intentionally removes aliases, but official clients and Gateways upgrade independently and the repository policy requires additive protocol evolution unless maintainers explicitly choose versioning and coordinated client follow-through.

options.title: Add compatibility aliases
options.body: Register both method and capability generations, make new clients fall back to the shipped names, and add mixed-version upgrade coverage before merge.

options.title: Version the protocol break
options.body: Bump the protocol with explicit minimum-version enforcement, coordinated native/CLI release sequencing, and upgrade documentation instead of allowing compatible handshakes to fail later.

options.title: Pause public renames
options.body: Land the internal `system-agent` refactor separately and defer user-facing protocol and command renames until the compatibility plan is ready.

recommendation.title: Add compatibility aliases
recommendation.body: Register both method and capability generations, make new clients fall back to the shipped names, and add mixed-version upgrade coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the umbrella product direction, the original shipped behavior, and this rename branch.
